# ArcTerra Expeditions (ARC | TERRA XY)

> Small-group and private expeditions by sea (ARCX: surf, dive, ocean exploration, yacht charter) and by land (TERRA Y: overland, polar, wildlife), plus SYZYGY eclipse expeditions. Polar voyages are offered as Polar Crossings by TERRA Y. Part of James Wild & Co.

## Journeys
- [Nutmeg & Fire, Banda Islands, 8 days by phinisi](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/banda-nutmeg-and-fire/)
- [Dragons & Corals, Komodo, 6 days](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/komodo-dragons-and-corals/)
- [Blue Hours, Banda dive liveaboard, 8 days](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/banda-dive-blue-hours/)
- [The Long Left, surf charter](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/surf-the-long-left/)
- [Thin Air, Tibet & Everest north face, 11 days](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/tibet-everest-thin-air/)
- [The Crossing, Katavi, Mahale & Masai Mara, 14 days](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/katavi-mahale-mara-the-crossing/)
- [Classic Antarctica Air-Cruise, 8 days with Antarctica21](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/antarctica-fly-cruise/)
- [South Georgia in Spring 2027, 17-day full-ship charter](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/south-georgia-spring-charter-2027/)

## Eclipse expeditions
- [Total solar eclipse Egypt 2 Aug 2027 and lunar eclipse Komodo 31 Dec 2028](https://arcterra.travel/eclipse-expeditions/)
- [Egypt by Nile and 4x4, and the Amazon annular eclipse 26 Jan 2028](https://arcterra.travel/eclipse-expeditions/egypt-and-amazon/)

## Journeys (live charts)
- [Nutmeg & Fire](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/banda-nutmeg-and-fire/): ARCX, 8 days. The Spice Islands, Indonesia. Eight days aboard the phinisi Dunia Baru from Ambon: Run, Banda Neira, Gunung Api, Batu Kapal, Pulau Ai and Nusa Laut.
- [Dragons & Corals](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/komodo-dragons-and-corals/): ARCX, 6 days. Komodo National Park, Indonesia. Six days from Labuan Bajo: Rinca dragons, the Padar viewpoint, Gili Lawa reefs and the mantas of Taka Makassar.
- [Blue Hours](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/banda-dive-blue-hours/): ARCX DIVE, 8 days. Banda Sea dive liveaboard, Indonesia. Up to 16 guided dives from Dunia Baru: the Run wall, Banda Neira lava-flow corals and the Batu Kapal pinnacles.
- [The Long Left](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/surf-the-long-left/): ARCX SURF, 8 days. Mentawai Islands, Indonesia. A boat expedition from Padang through the Playgrounds, Siberut, Sipora, Katiet and Pagai Utara, two sessions a day.
- [Thin Air](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/tibet-everest-thin-air/): TERRA Y, 11 days. Tibet & the North Face of Everest. Chengdu to Kathmandu: Lhasa, Yamdrok Tso, passes above 5,000 m and a night below Everest, paced for acclimatisation.
- [The Crossing](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/katavi-mahale-mara-the-crossing/): TERRA Y, 14 days. Katavi · Mahale · Masai Mara. Arusha to Nairobi: walking in Katavi, Mahale chimpanzees on Lake Tanganyika and the Mara River in crossing season.
- [Classic Antarctica Air-Cruise](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/antarctica-fly-cruise/): TERRA Y · POLAR CROSSINGS, 8 days. Antarctic Peninsula from Punta Arenas. Fly over the Drake to King George Island, then sail the South Shetlands and the Peninsula aboard Magellan Explorer.
- [South Georgia in Spring](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/south-georgia-spring-charter-2027/): TERRA Y · POLAR CROSSINGS, 17 days. Falklands & South Georgia, 2027. A full-ship charter of Magellan Explorer: king penguins, elephant seals in battle season and Shackleton’s Grytviken.
- [Eclipse Journeys](https://arcterra.travel/eclipse-expeditions/): SYZYGY, 8 days. Luxor 2027 · Komodo 2028. Totality at Luxor on 2 August 2027 and a New Year blood moon over Komodo on 31 December 2028.
- [Solar Journeys: Egypt & Amazon](https://arcterra.travel/eclipse-expeditions/egypt-and-amazon/): SYZYGY, 8 days. Luxor 2027 · Rio Negro 2028. Total eclipse by Red Sea yacht and Nile dahabiya, and the Amazon ring of fire by Rio Negro riverboat.
- [All journeys](https://arcterra.travel/journeys/)
